security_justification.trust_boundary: No trust boundary is defined, moved or crossed. The change edits glossary prose that no code, gate or kit reads.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority constructor, brand registry or provenance rule changes. The glossary records vocabulary only.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization mechanism changes. The example receiver's behaviour is described, not altered.
security_justification.audit_integrity: The audit event contract, its generation, validation and integrity are untouched. No event field changes.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secret, credential or confidential data is handled. Every term is defined without example values.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: No runtime object, freezing rule or mutation ownership changes. Only Markdown glossary text changes.
security_justification.fail_posture: No gate, check or failure path changes, so every fail-closed posture stays as it is.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No error code, diagnostic or disclosure path changes. The glossary names no error contents.
security_justification.concurrency: No concurrent execution, scheduling or shared state is introduced or changed.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK, sink or operation lifecycle state machine changes. Terms describe existing parts only.
security_justification.resource_retention: No storage, retention store or resource lifetime changes. Nothing is persisted.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, redelivery or delivery attempt behaviour changes. The existing delivery terms stay as they are.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic operation, digest computation or key handling changes. Kit identity is defined, not changed.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No privacy transformation hook or field redaction changes. No personal data appears.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security system, SIEM or exporter is integrated or referenced as available.
